_meta.description: Default brand-neutral professional theme for pdf-designer resume and cover-letter templates.
_meta.mode_contract: Light and dark are both intentional. Default print/PDF is light for ATS/submission safety; `--pdf-theme dark` keeps the same Letter pagination while rendering the dark branded variant.
_meta.privacy_note: This public theme is generalized and contains no personal brand names, private paths, or project-specific values.

document.footer_rule: Fixed print footers are supported, but templates must reserve bottom space through @page margins and deliberate page breaks.

paths.html_to_pdf_default: When no explicit output PDF is supplied, write under <html directory>/_exports/.
paths.png_default: When no explicit PNG output directory is supplied, write under <pdf directory>/_exports/<pdf-name>-png/.
paths.override: Use an explicit output path or --output-dir to target another folder.

light_pdf.purpose: ATS-safe submission PDF and ordinary printing.

dark_pdf.purpose: Branded portfolio/review PDF using dark colors while preserving Letter geometry.

png.purpose: Render any generated PDF to one PNG per page.

bundle_pdf.purpose: Combine exported documents, such as cover letter + resume, into one upload PDF.
bundle_pdf.validation: Use --require-letter for resume/application bundles so every page remains US Letter 8.5 x 11.

palette_sync.external_theme_kit_contract: Map external palette tokens into the pdf-designer names below. Do not change document geometry during palette sync unless the profile explicitly opts into another paper size.

brand.description: Cool teal primary, restrained gold secondary, soft violet accent, and professional blue support. Generic enough for a public default while avoiding a single-hue palette.

light.use: ATS-safe submission PDFs and ordinary print.

dark.use: Browser preview, branded PDF exports, and PNG preview artifacts.

fonts.note: Use heading_hub/body_hub for branded web previews. Use ats_submission for any resume or letter intended for ATS parsing.
